_comment: SCREEN-ANCHORED UI only, in normalized [0,1] coordinates of the NORMALIZED viewport
(brawl_vision.capture.normalize_viewport output), NOT of a raw capture frame.
EXCLUDED because they follow the world and belong to the entity chunk: the local player's
nameplate (measured to wander 330 px / 4.3 tiles horizontally), other players' nameplates,
loot boxes, and the auto-aim reticle. Also excluded: the transient 'Idle Warning' banner,
screen-anchored but rare, and covering it would cost a wide central band.
KNOWN GAP: no gadget button has been observed yet; none of the three clips has one.
GOES STALE if Supercell changes the UI layout. There is no auto-detection.

rects.name: brawlers_left
rects.note: match-state readout, top left. Solo Showdown only; the training cave shows 'Damage per second' here instead.

rects.name: chat_bubble
rects.note: emote/chat bubble, right edge. The bubble is a 124x102 px element that appears at TWO heights depending on whether a spectator/kill list is above it: y [252,355] in showdown_alternate_map and _map2, y [372,475] in the other four clips. The original rect covered only the lower one, and Phase L's mosaic showed the uncovered bubble smearing across the world canvas. Union of both, padded.

rects.name: attack_button
rects.note: primary attack. Measured independently in both Showdown and the cave at the same place, which is the evidence button layout is mode-independent.

rects.name: super_button
rects.note: super. Measured in the TRAINING CAVE -- the Showdown clip never charged one, so its position transfers on the strength of attack_button agreeing across modes.

rects.name: joystick
rects.note: FLOATING movement stick: it spawns wherever the thumb lands, so this is a motion ENVELOPE, not the stick. Measured spans in the Showdown clip were x=[0,447] y=[614,1084]; padded to the reachable bottom-left region. This one rect is ~11% of the frame -- two thirds of the whole mask -- and is the price of a floating control.
